issue: No authorized NFL gambling-use data feed or license is configured
why_flagged: Terms at nfl.com/terms restrict reuse; no license record exists; all empirical values must stay blank
remediation: Request license from NFL official distribution partner; record license ID; no scrape

issue: No verified executable market price archive
why_flagged: No timestamped odds feed with capture times and hashes; DraftKings pages define arithmetic only
remediation: Subscribe to licensed odds-close archive; store de-vigged probabilities on same line; moved lines blank

issue: No live official injury report snapshot exists in repo
why_flagged: Policy PDF requires Wed/Thu/Fri practice reports + Game Status + inactive list; repo holds design only, no dated PDFs
remediation: Capture 3 weekly PDFs + inactive lists with SHA-256 and ET timestamps before kickoff

issue: Depth-chart deficiency scores are blank (no licensed depth feed)
why_flagged: No official team-issued depth chart feed with 1st/2nd/3rd/4th string per position per game
remediation: License weekly depth-chart snapshots; compute deficiency = 1 − (starter snaps/expected); flag 2nd/3rd/4th-string starts

why_flagged: Pearson/phi require training-only paired residuals; currently no authorized observation ledger, so n=0
remediation: Populate only after ≥200 holdout bets / ≥60 slates; retain zeros; report slate-clustered CI

issue: Leaderboard empty — no strategy has passed all validation gates
why_flagged: Gates G01–G10 all open; empty ledger is fail-closed design; rewards are non-monetary research priority only
remediation: Do not publish ROI until holdout ≥200 bets / 60 slates and every gate artifact exists

issue: CLV and realized ROI are blank
why_flagged: Require de-vigged same-line close; moved lines excluded; no closing archive exists
remediation: Store closing_probabilities sidecar with same-line de-vigged probabilities; compute log(close_fair/entry_fair)

issue: Parlay joint probabilities blank — independence not assumed
why_flagged: Payout multiplication ≠ joint probability; need explicit joint sample and clustered CI
remediation: Require joint n and dependence CI before any parlay price; publish flagged warning

issue: Player-prop settlement rules not verified in repo
why_flagged: DraftKings over/under defines market vocabulary only; no licensed prop settlement verified
remediation: Capture provider prop settlement document and hash; store per-prop rules

remediation: Review docs/nfl/suggestions.html; record decision in COORDINATION.md; implement only after approval

issue: Two NBA references preserved for cross-project provenance
why_flagged: Cross-sport audit-trail pages are correctly labeled and not presented as NFL sources
remediation: Preserve NBA references with provenance note; do not imply NFL coverage

issue: Stale live labels in archive files are flagged, not hidden
why_flagged: Data files named live/forward but not refreshed are legacy; current dashboard treats them as archives
remediation: Publish archives as-is with flagged banner; current decision data comes only from docs/nfl/ with hashes
